module.name: Bedrock Smart-LLM Backend
module.description: Three single-model Bedrock shim pods (Nova Micro, Nova Lite, Claude 3 Haiku) behind a BNK Gateway + HTTPRoute + F5BigAnalyzer. Shim emits vllm:* metrics the builtin LLMLoadMonitor reads natively.

required.reason: BNK Gateway depends on bnk-gatewayclass being registered

required.name: bedrock_role_arn
required.description: IAM role ARN usable via IRSA. Auto-wired from app/bedrock-smartllm-irsa when both modules are deployed together from the eks-bnk-smartllm-demo blueprint. Trust policy must cover the default/bedrock-smartllm SA with bedrock:InvokeModel on the 3 foundation-model ARNs.

required.name: gateway_vip
required.description: IPv4 VIP for the BNK Gateway. Must be in the external VLAN's prefix and unused.

optional.name: aws_region
optional.description: AWS region Bedrock calls go to

optional.name: gateway_class
optional.description: GatewayClass name registered by BNK (via the BNKGatewayClass CR)

optional.name: gateway_name
optional.description: Name of the BNK Gateway this module creates

optional.name: httproute_name
optional.description: Name of the HTTPRoute the analyzer weights between the 3 Bedrock backends

optional.name: analyzer_name
optional.description: Name of the F5BigAnalyzer CR created by this module

optional.name: prometheus_endpoint
optional.description: HTTP URL the analyzer queries for vllm:* metrics

optional.name: prometheus_release_label
optional.description: Value of the `release` label Prometheus operator's serviceMonitorSelector matches

optional.name: shim_image
optional.description: Base image for shim init + runtime containers (ConfigMap-shipped Python source)

key_outputs.name: gateway_name
key_outputs.description: BNK Gateway name — client module targets this

key_outputs.name: gateway_vip
key_outputs.description: VIP the BNK Gateway binds on the external VLAN

key_outputs.name: gateway_url
key_outputs.description: Full base URL (http://<vip>) clients POST chat completions to — wired into client module's gateway_url

key_outputs.name: httproute_name
key_outputs.description: Name of the HTTPRoute whose backendRefs the analyzer weights
